items: A failed verified HTTPS probe cuts a visible hole in the ribbon instead of hiding behind a statistic.
Only adjacent successful probes contribute, so failures never get bridged into the calculation.
Monitor up to five HTTPS hosts to see whether one service is struggling or the connection is.
Run an on demand Cloudflare download and upload test without blocking the dashboard.
